claims.claim: The mill on the Harrow road was built in 1851 by the Teodor family.
claims.quote: The mill on the Harrow road was built in 1851 by the Teodor family

claims.claim: The wheel was cast in Sheffield and brought up the valley by cart.
claims.quote: the wheel was cast in Sheffield and carried up the valley on two carts

claims.claim: The mill kept working through the flood of 1898.
claims.quote: we ground on through the water, because the bread could not wait

claims.claim: The guide recommends the quarry path in wet weather.
claims.quote: Take the quarry path in wet weather, and the coast road only in June.
